lines.text: In 2010, NASA reported a place colder than Pluto.
Most people would guess Pluto is as cold as it gets. It averages about minus two hundred and thirty-two degrees.
But the colder spot was much closer to home.
It's on our own Moon, in a crater called Hermite.
NASA said it was the coldest temperature it had measured anywhere in the solar system, at the time.
So how cold is it in there? The full video has the number, and it's linked right here.
